messages:
emma: Quick sync — planning a dry-run deploy tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC for API/runtime/console/router during the change window. Goal: validate orchestration, canary waves, and rollback flows. Any objections?

raj: No objections. Question: are we pinning runtime model variant for the canary? I want runtime pinned to v2.1.3-quant on the initial shards.

oliver: +1 on pin. Runtime will run the pinned variant for canary shards only. Also proposing a KV cache eviction after deploy to avoid stale prefixes.

marta: Console note: frontend schema bump 1.4 -> 1.5. We have a feature flag for the UI toggle; backend API payloads are backward compatible. Console should deploy before we shift router traffic.

ben_sre: SRE checklist: healthchecks, steady-state metrics, tail latency. I'll wire a smoke-monitor to /health and p95 tokens. If p95 > 200ms for 3m we auto-hold.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled deploy created by @emma for 2024-11-03T02:00:00Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback policy: immediate rollback on error surge >1% or p95 > 250ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dryrun

emma: Thanks. Can we add an explicit step to pin router rules to avoid header-split surprises?

raj: Router team ok with header pin. I'll push this rule:

```
rbctl set-route --env=staging --header header_x=true --variant new-console
```

oliver: Runtime operational note: schedule KV eviction after deploy with a small grace window:

```
runtimectl kv-evict --pattern=prefix:* --grace=60s
```

marta: Console rollout plan (high level): deploy -> quick smoke (5 internal users) -> wave to 20% -> 100%. Manual hold at each wave; no auto-advance without an ACK.

ben_sre: Rollback criteria (summary): 1) error rate > 1% sustained for 2m; 2) p95 increase > 40% vs baseline for 3m; 3) canary-specific user-facing errors > 0.5%. If triggered, we execute rollback and notify channels + on-call.

emma: For release notes, I'll draft a short blurb mentioning model pin, router header pin, and rollback steps. Tagging @product for approval.

oliver: One more operational point: enable the compat layer for older client headers for 6 hours post-rollout. I'll toggle the flag after the final wave.

raj: Infra is all set. I'll be on-call during the window and can flip route rules if needed.

marta: I'll own console monitoring during the wave and will hold if UI errors spike.

ben_sre: SRE on-call (ben_sre) — monitoring alerts set. I'll escalate to infra/product if we see instability.

emma: Final preflight at 01:30 UTC. If no blockers, we let deploybot run the canary at 02:00 UTC.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight passed (all checks green). Executing canary at 02:00 UTC.

oliver: Watching logs now, ping me if you need me to flip compat flag.

raj: Ready to rollback if deploybot triggers the rollback policy.

marta: 👍 :thumbsup:

ben_sre: :white_check_mark:
